name: ALA-10
summary: ALA-10, also known as 1-acetyl-LAE (1A-LAE), is a psychedelic drug of the lysergamide family related to lysergic acid diethylamide (LSD). It is the 1-acetyl derivative of LAE-32. 1-Acetylated lysergamides like ALD-52 (1-acetyl-LSD; 1A-LSD) are thought to function as prodrugs via deacetylation to the 1-unsubstituted analogues, which in the case of ALD-52 is LSD.

pharmacology.text: ALA-10 shows antiserotonergic activity in the isolated rat uterus of about 39% of that of LSD but about 3 times stronger than that of LAE-32. Its pyretogenic potency in rabbits is only about 1% of that of LSD.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

uses.en: It is known only from early laboratory research on lysergamides and has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它只出現在早期的麥角醯胺實驗室研究中，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它只出现在早期的麦角酰胺实验室研究中，没有医疗用途。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Lysergamide psychedelics such as LSD can cause anxiety, confusion, altered perception and a raised heart rate, and can trigger psychosis in people who are prone to it.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響所知甚少。LSD 等麥角醯胺類迷幻藥可能引起焦慮、混亂、知覺改變與心跳加快，並可能在易感者身上誘發精神病。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响所知甚少。LSD 等麦角酰胺类迷幻药可能引起焦虑、混乱、知觉改变与心跳加快，并可能在易感者身上诱发精神病。

fact.en: Like ALD-52, it carries an acetyl group on the indole nitrogen of the lysergamide skeleton. In this family that group is thought to be removed in the body, releasing the parent drug.
fact.zh: 它和 ALD-52 一樣，在麥角醯胺骨架的吲哚氮上帶有乙醯基。在這個家族中，一般認為這個基團會在體內被移除，釋放出原本的母藥。
fact.zhHans: 它和 ALD-52 一样，在麦角酰胺骨架的吲哚氮上带有乙酰基。在这个家族中，一般认为这个基团会在体内被移除，释放出原本的母药。
